incidents_catalogued.title: Manifest-Derived TRAIN Independence Count (40) Contradicts Expected Prompt Value (23)
incidents_catalogued.location: ops02_physical_dataset_manifest_v1.json vs task prompt expected count
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Expected TRAIN independent parent datatakes = 23; prompt states: 'If manifest-derived count != 23: STOP and BLOCK. Do not force the expected value.'
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Authoritative physical manifest ops02_physical_dataset_manifest_v1.json, parent cluster manifest ops02_parent_cluster_manifest_v1.json, and freeze spec OPS02_DATASET_FREEZE_SPEC_v1.0.1.json independently and unanimously derive 40 TRAIN independent datatakes/clusters (out of 64 total: 40 TRAIN + 12 DEV + 12 HOLDOUT = 64). No manifest field evaluates to 23. If TRAIN were 23, total clusters would equal 47, violating the frozen 64-cluster specification.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Historical narrative typographical defect in LL-EXP07-019 text and C22-A report line 137 claiming '23 TRAIN datatakes', whereas the machine-checkable manifest and its automated test test_lesson_019_parent_datatake_accounting have always derived 40.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Per governance rules Part B and Part M ('If manifest-derived count != 23: STOP and BLOCK'), the agent refuses to force or fabricate numbers and strictly reports BLOCKED. Lineage and mathematical proofs documented in ops02_c22a6_independence_count_reconciliation_v1.json.

remediation_summary: Zero training occurred. Zero backward passes. Zero HOLDOUT access. Zero Part-III access. Task halted at BLOCKED in strict adherence to Part B and Part M governance mandates.
